notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 directed-interaction publication and send fence. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies directed-interaction lookup, object-class publication and subscription, target registration and discovery, whole-class unpublication boundaries, standard InteractionClassNotPublished failure, republication, targeted parameter delivery and metadata, unsubscription, and standard resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class directed-interaction publication, unpublication, subscription, targeted send, unsubscription, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and receiveDirectedInteraction callbacks
